hero.subtitle: Your investments and personal expenses in one smart tool. Better decisions start here.

features.title: The financial system that keeps up with real life
features.subtitle: From everyday spending to market context, Invistus helps you organize cash flow, automate reviews, and act with more confidence.

personalFinance.title: See your money in one place before the month drifts away.
personalFinance.description: Your dashboard, accounts, categories, and latest movements stay connected so the next decision feels obvious, not exhausting.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Track KPIs, cash flow, net worth, and category signals from a single home base.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: Review credits, debits, transfers, and merchants with filters built for real routines.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Keep bank, card, cash, investment, loan, and benefit accounts organized together.

summary.title: Monthly summary
summary.description: Spot how the month is closing before surprises pile up.

categorization.title: Smart categorization
categorization.description: Apply rules and bulk actions without losing control over the details.

tags.title: Tags and context
tags.description: Add your own lenses to analyze spending patterns the way you actually think about them.

automation.title: Categorize faster, import faster, and keep the audit trail.
automation.description: Invistus turns repetitive finance cleanup into guided flows, with rules, document imports, and review steps that keep you in charge.

imports.title: Statement and bill imports
imports.description: Bring OFX, CSV, Excel, and PDF data into the app instead of retyping the month by hand.

installments.title: Installment review
installments.description: Confirm parcel details before they distort the real cost of a purchase.

documentsNfce.title: Document and NFC-e intake
documentsNfce.description: Pull purchase evidence into your history so records are easier to trust and revisit.

recurringPayments.title: Never wonder which fixed bill is still waiting for you.
recurringPayments.description: Track subscriptions, utilities, and repeating commitments with pause, resume, reminders, and confirmations when the plan changes.

wishlist.title: Turn impulse into a purchase plan you can actually trust.
wishlist.description: Rank priorities, reorder ideas, and convert planned purchases into tracked transactions when the timing is right.

highlights.purchaseFlow: Mark as purchased and create the transaction

institutions.title: Follow financial institutions with more context than headlines give you.
institutions.description: Browse quarterly results, capital signals, profitability, and ratings for major institutions without hunting across disconnected sources.

indicators.title: Keep inflation, rates, and growth close to the decisions they affect.
indicators.description: Watch the indicators that move budgets, portfolios, and pricing power without opening five tabs to rebuild the story.

fixed_income_comparison.title: Compare fixed-income opportunities before yield marketing wins the room.
fixed_income_comparison.description: Put CDBs, LCIs, and LCAs side by side with taxes and liquidity in view, so the best rate is not the only thing driving the choice.
